# Font Cloud Server (tool_id: font-cloud)

Local font-subset cloud prototype (architecture leg A).

**Canonical tool pointer (share this path): `/font-cloud`**
- Machine descriptor: `/font-cloud.json`
- Human tool card: `/font-cloud`
- Human test bench: `/`

Do NOT use a generic `/tool` path — it does not identify this tool.

## Read these first

1. `/font-cloud.json` — tool identity + how to call `/api/subset`
2. `/docs/protocol.md` — API contract: /subset request/response, headers, errors, device call flow
3. `/docs/architecture.md` — full design (positioning, decisions, data flow, cache model, roadmap)
4. `/api/meta` — live capability negotiation JSON (includes `docs.canonical_path`) or fetch `/llms-full.txt` once.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| GET | /health | liveness |
| GET | /api/meta | protocol + capability |
| GET | /api/fonts | font registry |
| POST/GET | /api/subset | subset TTF by chars (POST JSON preferred) |
| GET | /api/stats | aggregated metrics |
| GET | /api/stats/history | recent request log |
| GET | / | interactive test bench (HTML) |
| GET | /docs/ | docs index (HTML) |

## Subset quick use

POST /api/subset
Content-Type: application/json

{"font": "misans-regular", "chars": "天青色等烟雨", "include_latin": false}

Returns font/ttf bytes. Key headers: X-Cache-Hit, X-Subset-Bytes, X-Subset-Ms, X-Subset-Missing, X-Cache-Key.

No `px` parameter by design: font size is a device-side rendering concern; one TTF subset is shared across sizes.

## Invariants

- Fixed UI strings are subset at build time (offline); this server serves dynamic text glyphs only.
- Server cache key = sha1(font_id + sorted(unique chars)); order/duplicates do not matter.
- Cache hit returns identical bytes as the first miss.

## Optional

- llms-full.txt — concatenated protocol + architecture for single-fetch learning
- /docs/protocol.md, /docs/architecture.md — source documents
